latest_release.name: V1.71.0 Sound
latest_release.body:
Mole

Deep clean and optimize your Mac.

### Changelog 1. `mo purge` protects projects in use: Build folders with open files or a running build are no longer listed or removed, including projects under non-ASCII paths. 2. Uninstall preserves more user data: Buzz models are kept by default, `--with-data` no longer preselects UTM and VirtualBuddy virtual machines, and containers protected by macOS are not moved to the Trash. 3. No permission prompt during uninstall: Without Full Disk Access, `mo uninstall` no longer measures other apps' containers, so the preview is not blocked by a system prompt. 4. `mo clean` preserves files that tools depend on: Puppeteer browsers and Buzz models are kept, `mo clean --external` continues past files whose size cannot be read, and a shell without write permission is refused with the reason. 5. `mo purge` reclaims more space: A Swift package `.build` folder that contains dependencies is offered as its compiler output only, and a configuration with no active paths falls back to the default folders. 6. Accurate memory and Bluetooth in `mo status`: Memory pressure is reported again, and connected Bluetooth devices are no longer shown as disconnected. 7. Multi-word search: List search matches rows that contain every word, in any order. 8. Performance and layout: `mo history` loads large logs about five times faster, `mo status --json` returns sooner, and long or wide names in `mo analyze` keep their endings and stay aligned. ### 更新日志 1. `mo purge` 保护使用中的项目：有文件被打开或正在构建的产物目录不再列出或删除，包含非 ASCII 字符的路径也能正确识别。 2. 卸载保留更多用户数据：Buzz 的模型默认保留，`--with-data` 不再预选 UTM 和 VirtualBuddy 的虚拟机，受 macOS 保护的容器不会移入废纸篓。 3. 卸载时不再触发权限弹窗：未授予完全磁盘访问权限时，`mo uninstall` 不再统计其他 App 容器的大小，预览不会被系统弹窗阻塞。 4. `mo clean` 保留工具依赖的文件：Puppeteer 安装的浏览器和 Buzz 的模型会保留，`mo clean --external` 遇到无法读取大小的文件时继续执行，Shell 没有写入权限时会说明原因并停止。 5. `mo purge` 可清理更多空间：包含依赖的 Swift 包 `.build` 目录现在只列出编译产物，配置中没有有效路径时使用默认目录。 6. `mo status` 的内存与蓝牙状态更准确：恢复显示内存压力，已连接的蓝牙设备不再显示为未连接。 7. 搜索支持多个关键词：列表搜索会匹配同时包含所有关键词的行，顺序不限。 8. 性能与显示：`mo history` 读取大日志的速度提升约五倍，`mo status --json` 返回更快，`mo analyze` 中较长或含宽字符的名称保留结尾并保持对齐。 ### Thanks Issue reporters and PR contributors this cycle: @viniciusdsandrade · @baryon · @hyeon0208 · @TyceHerrman. ### Mole Mac App If you would rather work in a window than a terminal, [Mole Mac App](https://mole.fit/) covers cleaning, app removal, maintenance, disk analysis and live status, shows everything before it deletes, and adds tools in the menu bar. It costs $19 once, with free updates and a 14-day refund, and you can [download it here](https://mole.fit/download). The CLI stays free and open source.

detail.readme:
macOS · Windows · Linux

Mole

Deep clean, uninstall, optimize, analyze disk and monitor your Mac. Free open-source CLI, plus a Mac app.

English · 中文 · 繁體 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Deutsch · Français · Polski · Українська · Русский

> 💡 This repo is the free open-source CLI (`mo`). Prefer a native app? [Mole for Mac](https://mole.fit/) is a separate download with review-before-delete cleanup, tested leftovers for 800+ apps, maintenance, disk drill-downs, live status, and fan controls on supported Macs. On Windows, the native app is [Mole for Windows](https://mole.fit/windows). `brew install mole` installs the CLI only. ## Features - **All-in-one CLI toolkit**: Combines CleanMyMac, AppCleaner, DaisyDisk, and iStat Menus style workflows in one terminal command - **Deep clean**: Removes caches, logs, leftovers, and orphaned app data to reclaim disk space - **Smart uninstaller**: Removes apps together with LaunchAgents, preferences, and leftovers - **Disk analyzer**: Visualizes disk usage with an interactive TUI, finds large files, and navigates directories - **System maintenance**: Flushes DNS, refreshes QuickLook/icons, and optimizes system databases - **Live monitoring**: Shows real-time CPU, memory, disk I/O, network traffic, and process stats ## Quick Start Mole requires macOS 12 or newer and supports both Intel and Apple Silicon Macs. If Homebrew no longer supports your macOS version, use the script install instead. **Install via Homebrew** ```bash brew install mole ``` **Or via script** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tw93/mole/main/install.sh | bash ``` **With an AI agent** Tell your agent: > Install Mole for me by reading https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tw93/Mole/main/llms.txt Or install the skill yourself. With it, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents show every cleanup with `--dry-run` before anything is removed, and leave app uninstalls and administrator steps to you. Update with `npx skills update -g -y`. ```bash npx skills add tw93/Mole -a claude-code codex cursor -g -y ``` As a host plugin: `/plugin marketplace add tw93/Mole` then `/plugin install mole@mole` in Claude Code, `codex plugin marketplace add tw93/Mole` then `codex plugin add mole@mole` in Codex, or `dsh plugin --profile add dsh-mole` in DeepSeek Harness. **Run** ```bash mo # Interactive menu mo clean # Deep cleanup + already-uninstalled app leftovers mo uninstall # Remove installed apps + their leftovers mo optimize # Refresh caches & services mo analyze # Visual disk explorer (or 'mo analyse') mo status # Live system health dashboard mo purge # Clean project build artifacts mo installer # Find and remove installer files mo slim # Remove Intel code from universal apps mo touchid # Configure Touch ID for sudo mo completion # Set up shell tab completion mo update # Update Mole mo update --nightly # Update to latest unreleased main build, script install only mo remove # Remove Mole from system mo --help # Show help mo --version # Show installed version ``` **Preview safely** ```bash mo clean --dry-run mo uninstall --dry-run mo optimize --dry-run mo purge --dry-run mo installer --dry-run mo slim --dry-run mo history mo history --json mo clean --dry-run --debug # Preview + detailed logs mo optimize --whitelist # Manage protected optimization rules mo clean --whitelist # Manage protected caches mo purge --paths # Configure project scan directories mo analyze /Volumes # Analyze external drives only mo analyze /private/tmp # Review user-owned temporary directories ```
Other install options To install a specific release, pass any tag from the [releases page](https://github.com/tw93/mole/releases), with or without its leading `V`. To track the development branch instead, pass `main`: ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tw93/mole/main/install.sh | bash -s -- 1.51.0 curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tw93/mole/main/install.sh | bash -s -- main ``` `main` installs unreleased code from the default branch, so expect rough edges. `latest` still works as a legacy alias for `main`; despite the name it does not install the newest stable release. The script normally installs to `/usr/local/bin`, which may ask for an administrator password. Install into a user-owned directory if you want future `mo update` runs to stay password-free: ```bash mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tw93/mole/main/install.sh | bash -s -- --prefix "$HOME/.local/bin" export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" ``` Add the same `PATH` export to `~/.zshrc` or your shell profile for new terminals. Mole updates the installation you invoked, so it keeps using this directory. Commands that change system-owned files may still request administrator access. **Nix** On macOS, Nix users can install the flake from `main`, which contains unreleased changes: ```bash nix profile install github:tw93/mole/main#mole nix profile upgrade mole nix profile remove mole ``` For a declarative installation, add `github:tw93/mole/main` as a flake input and use its `packages.${system}.mole` package. Update or remove Mole through Nix; `mo update` and `mo remove` leave Nix-managed installations unchanged.
**On Windows** ([Windows CLI](https://github.com/tw93/Mole/tree/windows#readme)) ```powershell iwr -useb https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tw93/Mole/windows/quick-install.ps1 | iex ``` **On Linux** ([Linux CLI](https://github.com/tw93/Mole/tree/linux#readme)) ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tw93/Mole/linux/install.sh | bash ``` Mole is only distributed through Homebrew, this repository and [mole.fit](https://mole.fit/). `molemac.com`, `moleapp.net` and `molefit.com` are not Mole, and the Windows app at `mole.bluecatbot.com` is a separate community project. ## Safety Mole can remove files, so it validates paths, protects shared and system-owned locations, and asks for confirmation when an action needs it. When Mole cannot prove an item is safe to change, it skips or refuses it. - `clean`, `uninstall`, `purge`, `installer`, `slim`, and `remove` can delete files, so review them with `--dry-run` first and add `--debug` when needed - Run Mole without `sudo`; it requests administrator access only when needed - `mo uninstall`, `mo analyze`, and `mo slim` route deletions to Trash by default after confirmation; `clean`, `purge`, and `installer` delete permanently. `mo uninstall --permanent` skips Trash - Cleanup activity is recorded in `~/Library/Logs/mole/operations.log`; review it with `mo history` or disable it with `MO_NO_OPLOG=1` - Protect caches with `mo clean --whitelist`, or maintenance items with `mo optimize --whitelist` - If the whitelist file cannot be read, `clean`, `purge`, and `optimize` stop instead of running without it Review [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) and [SECURITY_AUDIT.md](SECURITY_AUDIT.md) for reporting guidance, safety boundaries, and current limitations. ## Configuration Mole runs without configuration. These environment variables adapt it to slow disks, stalled network or cloud mounts; raise a timeout only when Mole reports that a step timed out. - `MOLE_TIMEOUT_QUICK_DETECT_SEC` (2): command-availability probes - `MOLE_TIMEOUT_SHORT_QUERY_SEC` (3): lightweight queries such as `df` and `tmutil status` - `MOLE_TIMEOUT_MEDIUM_PROBE_SEC` (5): probes that walk a directory tree or reach the network - `MOLE_TIMEOUT_PKG_LIST_SEC` (10): package-manager listings such as `brew list` - `MOLE_TIMEOUT_PKG_CLEANUP_SEC` (20): cache cleanups that walk the disk - `MOLE_TIMEOUT_DISK_VERIFY_SEC` (30): filesystem verify and repair - `MOLE_TIMEOUT_HINT_SCAN_SEC` (15): unbounded user-directory scans - `MOLE_CLOUD_OFFICE_SECTION_BUDGET_SEC` (300): overall budget for the cloud and Office cleanup section The number in parentheses is the default in seconds. For example, give the scans more time on a slow disk: ```bash MOLE_TIMEOUT_HINT_SCAN_SEC=60 MOLE_TIMEOUT_MEDIUM_PROBE_SEC=15 mo clean ``` ## Features in Detail The examples below are shortened. Available items, sizes, and skip reasons depend on your Mac. ### Clean `mo clean` reviews known-safe caches, logs, temporary files, developer artifacts, and leftovers from apps that are no longer installed. It empties `~/.Trash` by default; to keep it, select Trash in `mo clean --whitelist`, the same menu that protects caches you want to keep. Volume Trashes such as `/Volumes/*/.Trashes` are not emptied with it. Selections persist in `~/.config/mole/whitelist`. Before adding custom paths, open the menu and press Enter to save the selections, then append one path per line. An existing file replaces the optional defaults; built-in safety protections still apply. ```text $ mo clean Clean Your Mac ⚙ Apple Silicon | Free space: 219.0GB ➤ User essentials ✓ User app cache · 18 items, 2.4GB ✓ User app logs · 7 items, 12.8MB ✓ Trash · emptied, 9 items ➤ App caches ✓ App Store cache · 8 items, 248.5MB ➤ Browsers ✓ Safari cache · 24 items, 642.1MB ✓ Chrome cache · 31 items, 1.2GB ➤ Developer tools ✓ npm cache · cleaned ◎ pnpm cache · skipped (pnpm busy) ====================================================================== Cleanup complete Removed: 4.5GB · 97 items Free space: 223.5GB (+4.5GB) ====================================================================== ``` ### Uninstall `mo uninstall` removes an installed app together with related files that Mole can tie back to that app. It keeps shared data when another installed copy still uses it. If the app is already gone, use `mo clean` to look for leftovers. Personal data, including settings and plugins, is kept by default. Press `D` in the removal preview to select individual data paths. `mo uninstall --with-data` starts with that data selected, except browser profiles and App Group containers; the preview lists it separately and `D` still lets you keep any path. After removal, references in shell, Hook, or MCP configuration are listed by file and line only; Mole does not edit those configurations. ```text $ mo uninstall Select Apps to Remove 1/3 selected ➤ ● Photoshop 2024 4.20GB | 2mo ago ○ IntelliJ IDEA 2.80GB | 3d ago ○ Premiere Pro 3.40GB | 2w ago Files to be removed: ✓ Photoshop 2024, 4.20GB ✓ /Applications/Adobe Photoshop 2024/Adobe Photoshop 2024.app Personal data kept: ~/Library/Application Support/Adobe/Adobe Photoshop 2024 ~/Library/Preferences/com.adobe.Photoshop.plist D choose personal data ====================================================================== Uninstall complete Removed 1 app, freed 4.20GB: Photoshop 2024 ====================================================================== ``` ### Optimize `mo optimize` runs bounded maintenance for supported Finder, network, database, and macOS services. Tasks that are unnecessary, unsafe at the moment, or unavailable are skipped with a reason. Use `mo optimize --whitelist` to exclude tasks or path patterns, such as a long-lived mounted disk image at `/Volumes/mail` that should not show up as a detach candidate. ```text $ mo optimize Optimize ⚙ System 18/32 GB RAM | 616/926 GB Disk | Uptime 6d PERFORMANCE DIAGNOSIS ✓ No sustained high-CPU bottleneck detected ➤ Finder Cache Refresh ✓ QuickLook thumbnails refreshed ✓ Icon services cache rebuilt ➤ Network Cache Refresh ✓ DNS cache refreshed ➤ Database Optimization ◎ Close these apps before database optimization: Safari ➤ Disk Health ✓ Disk verify skipped ====================================================================== Optimization Complete Applied 2 optimizations 13 unchanged | 3 skipped | 1 unavailable ====================================================================== ``` ### Analyze `mo analyze` opens a terminal disk explorer. It supports arrow keys and Vim navigation, filtering, multi-selection, Finder preview, and confirmed moves to Trash. External drives are skipped from the default overview; inspect them with `mo analyze /Volumes` or a specific mount path. Use `mo analyze /private/tmp` to review user-owned temporary files without turning them into automatic cleanup targets. File-by-file scans count APFS clones that share all blocks once; fast folder estimates can still count shared blocks more than once. A size ending in `+` contains measured bytes from a partial scan; `unknown` means the size could not be measured. Results cut short by temporary failures such as timeouts do not replace complete cached measurements, and a later refresh can recover the missing data. Folders macOS will not let the terminal read stay partial until access changes. The terminal list keeps the 30 largest entries, so an unreadable entry may fall outside that list; the total still indicates a partial scan. Directory JSON output includes all scanned entries. `mo analyze --json /path` includes `scan_status` on the result and each entry: `complete`, `partial`, or `unavailable`. Numeric sizes contain measured bytes; a zero with `unavailable` does not mean an empty directory. Partial scans still exit successfully, so automation should inspect `scan_status`. Completeness applies within Mole's existing scan exclusions and does not promise an atomic filesystem snapshot. ```text $ mo analyze Analyze Disk (302.1GB free) Select a location to explore: ▶ 1. ████████████████████████ 47.9% | Home 75.4GB 2. ███████████ 22.0% | User Library 34.6GB 3. ███████ 14.2% | Applications 22.4GB 4. █████ 10.7% | System Library 16.9GB 5. ███ 5.2% | Old Downloads (90d+) 8.2GB >3mo ``` ### Status `mo status` is a read-only dashboard for hardware, system pressure, disk activity, network traffic, power, and processes. When the IPv4 default route uses a tunnel, network graphs use that interface’s rates to avoid counting the same traffic again on its physical carrier. JSON retains per-interface rates, including the routed tunnel; idle non-default tunnels stay hidden. ```text $ mo status Mole Status Health ● 92 MacBook Pro · M4 Pro · 32GB · macOS 26 ⚙ CPU ▦ Memory Total ████████████░░░░░░░ 45.2% Used ███████████░░░░░░░ 58.4% Load 0.82 / 1.05 / 1.23 (8 cores) Total 18.7 / 32.0 GB Core 1 ███████████████░░░░ 78.3% Free ████████░░░░░░░░░░ 41.6% Core 2 ████████████░░░░░░░ 62.1% Avail 13.3 GB ▤ Disk ⚡ Power Used █████████████░░░░░░ 67.2% Level ██████████████████ 100% Free 156.3 GB Status Charged Read ▮▯▯▯▯ 2.1 MB/s Health Normal · 423 cycles Write ▮▮▮▯▯ 18.3 MB/s Temp 58°C · 1200 RPM ⇅ Network ▶ Processes Down ▁▁█▂▁▁▁▁▁▁▁▁▇▆▅▂ 0.54 MB/s Zombies 3 · Chrome (4242) ×3 Up ▄▄▄▃▃▃▄▆▆▇█▁▁▁▁▁ 0.02 MB/s Code ▮▮▮▮▯ 42.1% Proxy HTTP · 192.168.1.100 Chrome ▮▮▮▯▯ 28.3% ``` The health score combines CPU, memory, disk capacity, SMART status, I/O, thermals, battery state, and uptime, with color-coded ranges. Press `k` to toggle the cat, `c` to cycle the number of CPU cores shown, or `q` to quit; display preferences are saved.
JSON, NDJSON, and process alerts - `mo analyze --json ~/Documents` returns a one-time disk report as JSON - `mo status --json` returns a one-time status snapshot as JSON - `mo status | jq '.health_score'` switches to JSON automatically when output is piped - `mo status --watch --interval 2s` streams newline-delimited JSON from a warm collector - `mo history --json` returns cleanup activity as JSON. Sessions include `run_id` (an opaque string, empty when no identity was logged) and `attribution`: `run` for identified runs, `command` for legacy command-based grouping, or `ambiguous` when legacy markers cannot distinguish interruption from overlapping runs. Recorded actions remain available; ambiguous counts cannot be assigned reliably to individual runs. An empty `ended_at` means no end marker was recorded - `mo uninstall --list` returns installed apps as JSON with `name`, `bundle_id`, `source`, `uninstall_name`, `path` and `size` ```text $ mo analyze --json ~/Documents { "path": "/Users/you/Documents", "overview": false, "entries": [ { "name": "Library", "path": "...", "size": 80939438080, "is_dir": true } ], "large_files": [ { "name": "backup.zip", "path": "...", "size": 8796093022 } ], "total_size": 168393441280, "total_files": 42187 } $ mo status --json { "host": "MacBook-Pro", "health_score": 92, "cpu": { "usage": 45.2, "logical_cpu": 8 }, "memory": { "total": 34359738368, "used": 20078972109, "used_percent": 58.4 }, "disks": [], "process_collected_at": "2026-08-29T12:30:00Z", "process_stale": false, "zombie_count": 3, "zombie_parents": [ { "pid": 4242, "name": "Google Chrome for Testing", "count": 3 } ], "zombie_parents_complete": true, "uptime": "3d 12h 45m" } ``` Zombie diagnostics are read-only and do not affect the health score or terminate processes. Before Mole has a successful process sample, `process_collected_at`, `process_stale`, `zombie_count`, and `zombie_parents_complete` are omitted and `zombie_parents` is `null`. Later fast/watch snapshots reuse the latest successful sample with its original `process_collected_at` and set `process_stale: true`; a live process sample sets it to `false`. A count of `0` means Mole measured no zombies. Parent summaries contain at most three known owners; `zombie_parents_complete: false` means attribution was unavailable, incomplete, or truncated. If one collector fails, `mo status --json` still prints the metrics that were collected, reports the failure on stderr, and exits successfully, the same way `--watch` keeps streaming. It exits 1 when none of CPU, memory, disk, or process metrics are available, or when JSON output fails. Status also supports read-only alerts for processes that stay above a CPU threshold. Use `--proc-cpu-threshold`, `--proc-cpu-window`, or `--proc-cpu-alerts=false` to tune or disable them.
### Purge `mo purge` finds rebuildable project artifacts such as `node_modules`, `target`, `.build`, `build`, and `dist`. It groups artifacts by project and permanently deletes only the items you confirm. Artifacts with file activity in the last 7 days, or activity Mole cannot verify, are unselected by default. Mole uses `fd` when available and falls back to `find`, and protects directories containing deployment keypair files, nested Git repositories, or Git-tracked files. Non-interactive runs require `mo purge --yes`; use `mo purge --dry-run` to review the candidates first. Use Page Up/Down or `h`/`l` to move a page, `[`/`]` to jump between projects, and `X` to skip a project and advance. `/` searches project paths and artifact names, `n` finds the next match without changing selections, and Enter opens the final path review. Reported space is an estimate; unmeasured artifacts and incomplete scans are identified explicitly.
Purge example output ```text $ mo purge Purge Project Artifacts Select Artifacts to Purge 6.00GB, 2 selected ➤ ● ┌ ~/Projects/website 3.80GB | node_modules | 28d ○ └ ~/Projects/website 186MB | dist | <1d ● ┌ ~/Projects/rust-app 2.20GB | target | 2mo ○ └ ~/Projects/rust-app 22MB | dist | <7d ====================================================================== Purge complete Estimated space freed: 6.00GB | Items: 2 | Free: 223.5GB ====================================================================== ```
Custom Scan Paths Run `mo purge --paths` to configure scan directories, or edit `~/.config/mole/purge_paths` directly: ```shell ~/Documents/MyProjects ~/Work/ClientA ~/Work/ClientB ``` When custom paths are configured, Mole scans only those directories. Otherwise, it uses defaults like `~/Projects`, `~/GitHub`, `~/dev`, and supported agent worktree containers. Discovery does not save an incomplete result. Artifact scans reach six levels below each configured root; add a nearer root for deeper projects. Purge removes rebuildable artifacts inside worktrees, never the worktrees themselves.
### Installer `mo installer` finds DMG, PKG, MPKG, ISO, XIP, and installer ZIP files in Downloads, Desktop, Homebrew caches, iCloud, Mail, Telegram, and other supported locations, and shows each item's size and source before removal. Discovery has a cumulative time limit: if a scan or metadata probe fails or times out, Mole discards the list and exits without selecting files. Corrupt and unreadable ZIP archives are skipped, symlinked scan roots are supported but symlinks beneath them are not followed, and selected files are checked again against their confirmed identity at the deletion boundary.
Installer example output ```text $ mo installer Select Installers to Remove, 3.83GB, 5 selected ➤ ● Photoshop_2024.dmg 1.20GB | Downloads ● IntelliJ_IDEA.dmg 850.6MB | Downloads ● Illustrator_Setup.pkg 920.4MB | Downloads ● PyCharm_Pro.dmg 640.5MB | Homebrew ● Acrobat_Reader.dmg 220.4MB | Downloads ○ AppCode_Legacy.zip 410.6MB | Downloads ====================================================================== Installers cleaned Removed 5 installers, freed 3.83GB ====================================================================== ```
### Slim `mo slim` removes the Intel code that universal apps carry on Apple Silicon Macs. It lists the apps you own that are signed with a Developer ID, with the size of each app's Intel code, and changes only the apps you select. Each app is slimmed on a copy, touching only main executables and nested code that carries its own signature; the copy replaces the app only after it keeps its Apple Silicon code and passes code signing and Gatekeeper checks, and the original moves to the Trash. App Store apps, Apple apps, apps set to open using Rosetta, apps owned by another user, and running apps are left alone. It needs no developer tools, and an app update brings the Intel code back. ## Quick Launchers
Raycast and Alfred setup Install five launchers for Clean, Uninstall, Optimize, Analyze, and Status: ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tw93/Mole/main/scripts/setup-quick-launchers.sh | bash ``` The script adds Raycast commands and, when Alfred preferences are present, matching Alfred workflows with the keywords `clean`, `uninstall`, `optimize`, `analyze`, and `status`. Raycast needs one manual setup: 1. Open **Raycast Settings > Extensions > Script Commands**. 2. Add `~/Library/Application Support/Raycast/script-commands` as a script directory. 3. Run **Reload Script Directories** in Raycast. The launchers auto-detect Terminal, iTerm2, Alacritty, kitty, WezTerm, Ghostty, Hyper, WindTerm, and Warp. Set `MO_LAUNCHER_APP=` to choose one; you can also run Mole directly in [Kaku](https://github.com/tw93/Kaku).
## Community Thanks to everyone who helped build Mole. Go follow them. ❤️

Real feedback from users who shared Mole on 𝕏. Watch the [Mole tutorial video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UEe9-w4CcQ0) by PAPAYA 電腦教室. ## Support - Getting [Mole for Mac](https://mole.fit) is the most direct way to support Mole's development - If Mole helped you, give it a star, [share it](https://x.com/intent/tweet?url=https://github.com/tw93/Mole&text=Mole%20-%20Deep%20clean%20and%20optimize%20your%20Mac.), or open an issue or PR - I have two cats, TangYuan and Coke, and if Mole makes your life a little easier, feel free to treat them to canned food 🥩 These lovely people already did 🐱 ## License Mole is open source under GPL-3.0; see [LICENSE](LICENSE). Any modified version you share must remain under the same license. If you fork Mole, please use a distinct name and credit Mole as the upstream source. [Mole for Mac](https://mole.fit) is a separate proprietary app, and Mole is here for the long run.

English · 中文 · 繁體 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Deutsch · Français · Polski · Українська · Русский

> 💡 这个仓库是免费开源的命令行工具（`mo`），喜欢图形界面的话可以单独下载 [Mole for Mac](https://mole.fit/)，支持删除前逐项确认、实测 800 多款软件的卸载残留、系统维护、逐层分析磁盘空间、实时状态监控，以及在支持的 Mac 上控制风扇，Windows 上对应的原生 App 是 [Mole for Windows](https://mole.fit/zh/windows)，`brew install mole` 只会安装命令行工具。 ## 功能 - **多合一命令行**：把 CleanMyMac、AppCleaner、DaisyDisk 与 iStat Menus 的日常用法放进一个终端命令 - **深度清理**：清除系统缓存、应用日志与卸载残留，释放磁盘空间 - **应用卸载**：移除应用程序，同步清理配置文件与自启动项 - **磁盘分析**：终端交互式浏览目录层级，定位占用空间的大文件 - **系统优化**：刷新 DNS、QuickLook 与图标缓存，优化系统数据库 - **实时监控**：在终端看板中实时查看 CPU、内存、磁盘读写、网络流量与进程 ## 快速开始 Mole 支持 macOS 12 及更高版本，兼容 Intel 与 Apple Silicon 芯片，Homebrew 不再支持你的 macOS 版本时改用脚本安装。 **通过 Homebrew 安装** ```bash brew install mole ``` **通过脚本安装** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tw93/mole/main/install.sh | bash ``` **用 AI Agent 安装** 直接告诉你的 Agent： > Install Mole for me by reading https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tw93/Mole/main/llms.txt 也可以自己装 skill，装上后 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 Agent 删东西前会先用 `--dry-run` 把清单给你看，卸载 App 和要管理员权限的步骤留给你自己跑，更新用 `npx skills update -g -y`。 ```bash npx skills add tw93/Mole -a claude-code codex cursor -g -y ``` 喜欢用宿主自带的插件管理，Claude Code 里先 `/plugin marketplace add tw93/Mole` 再 `/plugin install mole@mole`，Codex 里先 `codex plugin marketplace add tw93/Mole` 再 `codex plugin add mole@mole`，DeepSeek Harness 里用 `dsh plugin --profile add dsh-mole`。 **常用命令** ```bash mo # 打开交互式菜单 mo clean # 深度清理与已卸载应用残留 mo uninstall # 卸载应用及其残留 mo optimize # 刷新系统缓存与服务 mo analyze # 磁盘空间浏览（也可写 mo analyse） mo status # 实时系统健康看板 mo purge # 清理项目构建产物 mo installer # 查找并删除安装包 mo slim # 移除通用应用里的 Intel 代码 mo touchid # 配置终端 Touch ID 指纹提权 mo completion # 配置命令行 Tab 键自动补全 mo update # 检查并更新 Mole mo update --nightly # 更新到最新未发布的开发版（仅限脚本安装） mo remove # 从系统中完全卸载 Mole mo --help # 查看帮助信息 mo --version # 查看已安装版本 ``` **安全预览** ```bash mo clean --dry-run mo uninstall --dry-run mo optimize --dry-run mo purge --dry-run mo installer --dry-run mo slim --dry-run mo history mo history --json mo clean --dry-run --debug # 安全预览 + 详细诊断日志 mo optimize --whitelist # 管理受保护的优化规则 mo clean --whitelist # 管理受保护的缓存白名单 mo purge --paths # 配置代码项目扫描目录 mo analyze /Volumes # 仅分析外接移动硬盘或磁盘卷 mo analyze /private/tmp # 仅查看临时目录（不自动清理） ```
其他安装选项 想装特定版本就传入 [Releases 页面](https://github.com/tw93/mole/releases) 里的任意 Tag，带不带开头的 `V` 都行，想跟开发分支就传 `main`： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tw93/mole/main/install.sh | bash -s -- 1.51.0 curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tw93/mole/main/install.sh | bash -s -- main ``` `main` 会安装默认分支上还没发布的代码，可能不稳定，`latest` 只是 `main` 的旧别名，并不会安装最新稳定版。 安装脚本默认装到 `/usr/local/bin`，可能需要输入管理员密码。希望以后的 `mo update` 不用输密码，可以装到用户目录： ```bash mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tw93/mole/main/install.sh | bash -s -- --prefix "$HOME/.local/bin" export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" ``` 记得把 `export PATH` 加到 `~/.zshrc` 或相应的终端配置文件。Mole 更新的是你运行的那份安装，之后会一直用这个目录，需要改系统文件的命令仍可能要管理员权限。 **Nix** 在 macOS 上，Nix 用户可从 `main` 分支安装 flake，其中包含还没发布的改动： ```bash nix profile install github:tw93/mole/main#mole nix profile upgrade mole nix profile remove mole ``` 声明式配置可以把 `github:tw93/mole/main` 加为 flake input，用它的 `packages.${system}.mole` 包。Nix 管理的安装要通过 Nix 升级和卸载，`mo update` 和 `mo remove` 不会改动它。
**Windows 上安装**（[Windows CLI](https://github.com/tw93/Mole/tree/windows#readme)） ```powershell iwr -useb https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tw93/Mole/windows/quick-install.ps1 | iex ``` **Linux 上安装**（[Linux CLI](https://github.com/tw93/Mole/tree/linux#readme)） ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tw93/Mole/linux/install.sh | bash ``` Mole 只通过 Homebrew、这个仓库和 [mole.fit](https://mole.fit/) 发布，`molemac.com`、`moleapp.net`、`molefit.com` 都不是 Mole，`mole.bluecatbot.com` 上的 Windows App 是同名的社区项目。 ## 安全机制 Mole 会删除文件，所以会先校验路径、保护共享和系统目录，需要时才请你确认，无法确认安全的项目一律跳过或拒绝。 - `clean`、`uninstall`、`purge`、`installer`、`slim` 与 `remove` 会删除文件，可先用 `--dry-run` 预览，需要时加上 `--debug` - 日常运行 **无需 `sudo`**，仅在触及系统级清理时按需请求管理员权限 - `mo uninstall`、`mo analyze` 与 `mo slim` 在确认后默认将删除项移入废纸篓；`clean`、`purge` 与 `installer` 为永久删除，`mo uninstall --permanent` 可跳过废纸篓 - 清理操作记录在 `~/Library/Logs/mole/operations.log` 中，可通过 `mo history` 查看，或设置 `MO_NO_OPLOG=1` 禁用 - 可通过 `mo clean --whitelist` 保护指定缓存，或使用 `mo optimize --whitelist` 排除维护项 - 白名单文件无法读取时，`clean`、`purge` 和 `optimize` 会直接停止，不会在没有白名单的情况下继续执行 漏洞报告方式、安全边界与当前限制见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) 与 [SECURITY_AUDIT.md](SECURITY_AUDIT.md)。 ## 配置 Mole 无需配置即可运行。以下环境变量用于适配慢速磁盘、卡住的网络或云挂载；仅当 Mole 提示某一步 `timed out` 时才需要调大对应的超时。 - `MOLE_TIMEOUT_QUICK_DETECT_SEC` (2): 命令可用性探测 - `MOLE_TIMEOUT_SHORT_QUERY_SEC` (3): 轻量查询，如 `df` 与 `tmutil status` - `MOLE_TIMEOUT_MEDIUM_PROBE_SEC` (5): 遍历目录树或访问网络的探测 - `MOLE_TIMEOUT_PKG_LIST_SEC` (10): 包管理器列表，如 `brew list` - `MOLE_TIMEOUT_PKG_CLEANUP_SEC` (20): 遍历磁盘的缓存清理 - `MOLE_TIMEOUT_DISK_VERIFY_SEC` (30): 文件系统校验与修复 - `MOLE_TIMEOUT_HINT_SCAN_SEC` (15): 无上限的用户目录扫描 - `MOLE_CLOUD_OFFICE_SECTION_BUDGET_SEC` (300): 云盘与 Office 清理环节的总预算 括号中的数字为默认秒数。例如，在慢速磁盘上给扫描更多时间： ```bash MOLE_TIMEOUT_HINT_SCAN_SEC=60 MOLE_TIMEOUT_MEDIUM_PROBE_SEC=15 mo clean ``` ## 功能说明 以下展示为缩减示例，具体显示项、大小与跳过原因取决于你的 Mac 实际环境。 ### 深度清理（Clean） `mo clean` 扫描并清理已知可安全删除的缓存、日志、临时文件、开发工具缓存以及已卸载应用的残留，默认会清空 `~/.Trash`，想保留就在 `mo clean --whitelist` 里勾选 Trash，同一个菜单也用来保护想留下的缓存，各卷的废纸篓（如 `/Volumes/*/.Trashes`）不会随之清空。选好的项会写进 `~/.config/mole/whitelist`，想加自定义路径时先打开菜单按回车保存一次，再往文件里每行追加一个路径，文件一旦存在就会替换可选默认规则，内置安全保护仍然生效。 ```text $ mo clean Clean Your Mac ⚙ Apple Silicon | Free space: 219.0GB ➤ User essentials ✓ User app cache · 18 items, 2.4GB ✓ User app logs · 7 items, 12.8MB ✓ Trash · emptied, 9 items ➤ App caches ✓ App Store cache · 8 items, 248.5MB ➤ Browsers ✓ Safari cache · 24 items, 642.1MB ✓ Chrome cache · 31 items, 1.2GB ➤ Developer tools ✓ npm cache · cleaned ◎ pnpm cache · skipped (pnpm busy) ====================================================================== Cleanup complete Removed: 4.5GB · 97 items Free space: 223.5GB (+4.5GB) ====================================================================== ``` ### 应用卸载（Uninstall） `mo uninstall` 移除已安装的应用，以及 Mole 能确认属于这个应用的相关文件；若同一应用的另一个已安装副本仍在使用这些文件，会自动保留，应用此前已被手动删除的话，运行 `mo clean` 扫描残留。 设置、插件等个人数据默认保留，在卸载预览页按 `D` 可逐项选择要删除的数据路径，用 `mo uninstall --with-data` 时这些数据会预先选中，浏览器配置文件与 App Group 容器除外，预览里单独列出，仍可按 `D` 保留任意路径，卸载后若发现 shell、Hook 或 MCP 配置仍引用已删除的路径，只提示文件和行号，不修改配置。 ```text $ mo uninstall Select Apps to Remove 1/3 selected ➤ ● Photoshop 2024 4.20GB | 2mo ago ○ IntelliJ IDEA 2.80GB | 3d ago ○ Premiere Pro 3.40GB | 2w ago Files to be removed: ✓ Photoshop 2024, 4.20GB ✓ /Applications/Adobe Photoshop 2024/Adobe Photoshop 2024.app Personal data kept: ~/Library/Application Support/Adobe/Adobe Photoshop 2024 ~/Library/Preferences/com.adobe.Photoshop.plist D choose personal data ====================================================================== Uninstall complete Removed 1 app, freed 4.20GB: Photoshop 2024 ====================================================================== ``` ### 系统优化（Optimize） `mo optimize` 对支持的 Finder、网络、数据库与 macOS 服务执行范围明确的维护，非必要、当前执行不安全或不可用的任务会跳过并说明原因。可用 `mo optimize --whitelist` 排除任务或路径模式，例如常驻挂载的 `/Volumes/mail`，避免它出现在推出列表里。 ```text $ mo optimize Optimize ⚙ System 18/32 GB RAM | 616/926 GB Disk | Uptime 6d PERFORMANCE DIAGNOSIS ✓ No sustained high-CPU bottleneck detected ➤ Finder Cache Refresh ✓ QuickLook thumbnails refreshed ✓ Icon services cache rebuilt ➤ Network Cache Refresh ✓ DNS cache refreshed ➤ Database Optimization ◎ Close these apps before database optimization: Safari ➤ Disk Health ✓ Disk verify skipped ====================================================================== Optimization Complete Applied 2 optimizations 13 unchanged | 3 skipped | 1 unavailable ====================================================================== ``` ### 磁盘分析（Analyze） `mo analyze` 打开终端交互式磁盘分析器，支持方向键与 Vim 快捷键浏览、快速过滤、多选标记、Finder 预览与移入废纸篓。外置磁盘默认不在概览中显示，可运行 `mo analyze /Volumes` 或指定挂载路径单独查看，`mo analyze /private/tmp` 只检查临时目录，不会把它们变成自动清理目标。逐文件扫描时，共享全部数据块的 APFS 克隆只计一次，文件夹快速估算仍可能重复计算共享块。 以 `+` 结尾的大小是部分扫描里实际测到的字节数，`unknown` 表示没法测出大小。因临时超时中断的条目不会覆盖已有完整缓存，后续刷新可自动补全。macOS 不允许终端读取的文件夹会一直标为部分扫描，直到访问权限改变。终端界面只列出最大的 30 项，读不到的条目可能不在这 30 项里，但总量仍会标为部分扫描，JSON 格式输出则包含所有扫描条目。 `mo analyze --json /path` 的结果本身和其中每一项都带有 `scan_status`（`complete`、`partial` 或 `unavailable`）。数值大小是实际测到的字节数，`unavailable` 时的 0 也不代表目录为空。未完成的扫描仍返回退出码 0，脚本要看 `scan_status` 判断结果是否完整。完整性以 Mole 现有的扫描排除规则为界，不保证是文件系统的原子快照。 ```text $ mo analyze Analyze Disk (302.1GB free) Select a location to explore: ▶ 1. ████████████████████████ 47.9% | Home 75.4GB 2. ███████████ 22.0% | User Library 34.6GB 3. ███████ 14.2% | Applications 22.4GB 4. █████ 10.7% | System Library 16.9GB 5. ███ 5.2% | Old Downloads (90d+) 8.2GB >3mo ``` ### 状态监控（Status） `mo status` 提供只读系统硬件仪表盘，涵盖 CPU、系统负载、磁盘读写、网络流量、电源与进程。 当默认 IPv4 路由走 VPN 或隧道接口时，流量图表会统计这个接口，避免和物理网卡重复计算。JSON 输出保留每个接口的速率，包括路由经过的隧道，空闲的非默认隧道不显示。 ```text $ mo status Mole Status Health ● 92 MacBook Pro · M4 Pro · 32GB · macOS 26 ⚙ CPU ▦ Memory Total ████████████░░░░░░░ 45.2% Used ███████████░░░░░░░ 58.4% Load 0.82 / 1.05 / 1.23 (8 cores) Total 18.7 / 32.0 GB Core 1 ███████████████░░░░ 78.3% Free ████████░░░░░░░░░░ 41.6% Core 2 ████████████░░░░░░░ 62.1% Avail 13.3 GB ▤ Disk ⚡ Power Used █████████████░░░░░░ 67.2% Level ██████████████████ 100% Free 156.3 GB Status Charged Read ▮▯▯▯▯ 2.1 MB/s Health Normal · 423 cycles Write ▮▮▮▯▯ 18.3 MB/s Temp 58°C · 1200 RPM ⇅ Network ▶ Processes Down ▁▁█▂▁▁▁▁▁▁▁▁▇▆▅▂ 0.54 MB/s Zombies 3 · Chrome (4242) ×3 Up ▄▄▄▃▃▃▄▆▆▇█▁▁▁▁▁ 0.02 MB/s Code ▮▮▮▮▯ 42.1% Proxy HTTP · 192.168.1.100 Chrome ▮▮▮▯▯ 28.3% ``` 健康评分综合了 CPU、内存、磁盘余量、SMART 状态、I/O 读写、温度、电池状况与运行时间，按 `k` 切换看板小猫，按 `c` 调整显示的 CPU 核心数，按 `q` 退出，设置会自动保存。
JSON、NDJSON 与进程告警 - `mo analyze --json ~/Documents`：单次输出指定路径的磁盘分析 JSON - `mo status --json`：单次输出系统状态快照 JSON - `mo status | jq '.health_score'`：当输出被管道重定向时自动切换为 JSON 模式 - `mo status --watch --interval 2s`：持续流式输出 NDJSON（换行分隔的 JSON） - `mo history --json`：以 JSON 格式输出历史清理日志。每个会话带有 `run_id`（不透明字符串，没有记录身份时为空）和 `attribution`，能识别的运行是 `run`，旧版按命令分组的是 `command`，旧标记分不清中断和重叠运行时是 `ambiguous`。记录下来的操作仍然都能看到，但 `ambiguous` 的计数没法可靠地分到单次运行上。`ended_at` 为空表示没有记录到结束标记 - `mo uninstall --list`：以 JSON 输出已安装应用，字段为 `name`、`bundle_id`、`source`、`uninstall_name`、`path` 和 `size` ```text $ mo analyze --json ~/Documents { "path": "/Users/you/Documents", "overview": false, "entries": [ { "name": "Library", "path": "...", "size": 80939438080, "is_dir": true } ], "large_files": [ { "name": "backup.zip", "path": "...", "size": 8796093022 } ], "total_size": 168393441280, "total_files": 42187 } $ mo status --json { "host": "MacBook-Pro", "health_score": 92, "cpu": { "usage": 45.2, "logical_cpu": 8 }, "memory": { "total": 34359738368, "used": 20078972109, "used_percent": 58.4 }, "disks": [], "process_collected_at": "2026-08-29T12:30:00Z", "process_stale": false, "zombie_count": 3, "zombie_parents": [ { "pid": 4242, "name": "Google Chrome for Testing", "count": 3 } ], "zombie_parents_complete": true, "uptime": "3d 12h 45m" } ``` 僵尸进程诊断是只读的，不会结束进程，也不影响健康分。Mole 还没成功拿到一次进程样本时，`process_collected_at`、`process_stale`、`zombie_count` 和 `zombie_parents_complete` 都不会出现，`zombie_parents` 为 `null`。之后的 fast/watch 快照会沿用最近一次成功的样本，保留它原来的 `process_collected_at` 并设 `process_stale: true`，拿到新的进程样本后变回 `false`。`0` 表示 Mole 实际测过，没有僵尸进程。父进程摘要最多列出三个已知的父进程，`zombie_parents_complete: false` 表示归属信息拿不到、不完整或被截断。 如果某个指标采集出错，`mo status --json` 仍会输出其他可用指标，将错误记录在 stderr 中并退出 0，`--watch` 也是这样继续输出，只有 CPU、内存、磁盘和进程指标全都拿不到，或者 JSON 输出失败时才退出 1。 持续高 CPU 的进程会有提示，用 `--proc-cpu-threshold`、`--proc-cpu-window` 或 `--proc-cpu-alerts=false` 调整或关闭。
### 项目清理（Purge） `mo purge` 自动查找可随时重新构建的项目生成目录（如 `node_modules`、`target`、`.build`、`build` 与 `dist`）。按项目归类展示，只永久删除你勾选确认的产物，不经过废纸篓，最近 7 天内有改动或无法确认改动时间的产物默认不勾选。扫描优先用 `fd`，没有时回退到 `find`，包含部署密钥、嵌套 Git 仓库或 Git 追踪文件的目录会受保护，非交互式运行需加 `--yes`，可先用 `mo purge --dry-run` 预览候选目录。 使用 Page Up/Down 或 `h`/`l` 翻页，`[`/`]` 在项目间跳转，`X` 跳过当前项目并前进到下一个，`/` 搜索项目路径与产物名称，`n` 跳到下一个匹配且不改变已选项，回车打开最终路径确认界面。显示的空间是估算值，没测出大小的产物和不完整的扫描会单独标明。
Purge 示例输出 ```text $ mo purge Purge Project Artifacts Select Artifacts to Purge 6.00GB, 2 selected ➤ ● ┌ ~/Projects/website 3.80GB | node_modules | 28d ○ └ ~/Projects/website 186MB | dist | <1d ● ┌ ~/Projects/rust-app 2.20GB | target | 2mo ○ └ ~/Projects/rust-app 22MB | dist | <7d ====================================================================== Purge complete Estimated space freed: 6.00GB | Items: 2 | Free: 223.5GB ====================================================================== ```
自定义扫描路径 运行 `mo purge --paths` 配置扫描目录，或直接编辑 `~/.config/mole/purge_paths`： ```shell ~/Documents/MyProjects ~/Work/ClientA ~/Work/ClientB ``` 配置了自定义路径就只扫描这些目录，没配置时用默认目录（如 `~/Projects`、`~/GitHub`、`~/dev` 以及受支持的 agent worktree 目录），扫描中途得到的不完整结果不会保存。产物扫描深度为配置根目录下 6 层，更深的项目可以加一个更近的根目录，Purge 只删除 worktree 里可重建的产物，不会删除 worktree 目录本身。
### 安装包清理（Installer） `mo installer` 自动查找下载目录、桌面、Homebrew 缓存、iCloud、Mail、Telegram 等受支持位置中的 DMG、PKG、MPKG、ISO、XIP 与安装器 ZIP 文件，清理前列出各文件大小与来源。扫描有总时长上限，出错或超时就直接放弃，不在不完整的数据上操作，损坏或无法读取的 ZIP 压缩包会跳过，扫描根目录可以是符号链接，但不会跟随它下面的符号链接，最终删除前还会再校验一次，确保文件未发生变动。
Installer 示例输出 ```text $ mo installer Select Installers to Remove, 3.83GB, 5 selected ➤ ● Photoshop_2024.dmg 1.20GB | Downloads ● IntelliJ_IDEA.dmg 850.6MB | Downloads ● Illustrator_Setup.pkg 920.4MB | Downloads ● PyCharm_Pro.dmg 640.5MB | Homebrew ● Acrobat_Reader.dmg 220.4MB | Downloads ○ AppCode_Legacy.zip 410.6MB | Downloads ====================================================================== Installers cleaned Removed 5 installers, freed 3.83GB ====================================================================== ```
### 应用瘦身（Slim） `mo slim` 在 Apple Silicon Mac 上移除通用应用里的 Intel 代码。它列出归你所有、使用 Developer ID 签名的应用及各自的 Intel 代码大小，只处理你选中的应用。每个应用先在副本上瘦身，只动主程序和自带签名的嵌套代码，副本保留 Apple Silicon 代码并通过代码签名与 Gatekeeper 检查后才替换原应用，原应用移入废纸篓。App Store 应用、Apple 应用、设为使用 Rosetta 打开的应用、属于其他用户的应用以及正在运行的应用都不会处理。不需要安装开发工具，应用更新后 Intel 代码会回来。 ## 快捷启动器
Raycast 与 Alfred 配置 安装快捷启动器（Clean、Uninstall、Optimize、Analyze 与 Status）： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tw93/Mole/main/scripts/setup-quick-launchers.sh | bash ``` 脚本会添加 Raycast 命令，检测到 Alfred 配置时还会添加带有 `clean`、`uninstall`、`optimize`、`analyze` 与 `status` 关键词的 Alfred Workflow。 Raycast 装好后要手动设置一次： 1. 打开 **Raycast 设置 > Extensions > Script Commands**。 2. 添加 `~/Library/Application Support/Raycast/script-commands` 目录。 3. 在 Raycast 中点击 **Reload Script Directories**。 启动器会自动适配常见终端（Terminal、iTerm2、Alacritty、kitty、WezTerm、Ghostty、Hyper、WindTerm、Warp）。可通过 `MO_LAUNCHER_APP=<名称>` 指定终端，也可以直接在 [Kaku](https://github.com/tw93/Kaku) 中运行。
